name: StarterPack
author: Oddisz
description: Build a starting loadout once and stamp it onto every new game. Pick ships, their weapons, fighters, hullmods, S-mods and D-mods, your cargo, credits, skill points, story points and hotbar layout from a main-menu editor. Templates live in saves/common, so they survive save deletion and mod updates. Applied once per campaign, either automatically on new game or with the 'starterpack' console command.
